title: Title on the cross: King of the Jews
english: They [[put over his head the charge written: This is Jesus, the king of the Jews >> Bible:Matthew 27:37]]. By occasion or by truth Christ is proclaimed king, and every letter — Greek, Roman, Hebrew — witnesses his kingdom. No other cause of death is found except: he was King of the Jews — [[I have been set as king by him on Zion >> Bible:Psalm 2:6]].
translator_notes: PG 13 Latin Series CLOSEOUT arc; no Heine.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Guards bribed; false witness after the rising
english: Gathered with the elders they took counsel to [[give money to the soldiers to say: His disciples stole him by night while we slept >> Bible:Matthew 28:12-13]]. Those who read [[You shall not bear false witness >> Bible:Exodus 20:16]] invited others into false witness. Glory to Christ rising. Amen.
translator_notes: Series CLOSEOUT tip — passion/resurrection end of Commentariorum Series in PG 13 before Luke Homilies.
